data.additional_information:
Location: Bangalore (On-Site)
Employment Type: Full-Time Offer
Experience: 0–5 Years
Compensation: Compensation will be at par with industry standards and will be determined based on the candidate’s experience, technical skills, and overall interview performance.

Eligible Candidates
Final-year or recently graduated M.Tech candidates seeking a full-time opportunity
Ph.D. scholars in Computer Science, Engineering, or related technology domains
Candidates from the teaching/academic field (Assistant Professors, Lecturers, Teaching Assistants, Academic Instructors) with strong domain knowledge in Web Development / Computer Science / Software Engineering
Individuals passionate about Computer Science, Web Development, AI, Cloud, and Engineering Education

About uGSOT
upGrad School of Technology (uGSOT) is a next-generation engineering education initiative designed to transform how computer science and software engineering are taught in India. As part of upGrad — South Asia’s largest higher education technology platform empowering millions of learners globally — uGSOT blends rigorous academic foundations with industry-driven practice and emerging technologies to prepare engineers for the future of work.
Unlike traditional programs, uGSOT partners with leading universities to offer UGC-recognised technology programs that integrate hands-on project work, modern technology stacks, AI and Cloud emphasis, and industry mentorship from practicing engineers. The curriculum is continuously updated to reflect the latest in software development, deep tech, and real-world engineering needs, helping graduates stay ahead in a rapidly changing tech landscape.
The School focuses on immersive learning experiences, including full-stack development, cloud computing, AI tools, real-world projects, and practical labs, ensuring learners not only understand concepts but also build solutions that mirror real industry problems. uGSOT’s mission is to create a new generation of engineers who are technically exceptional and innovation-ready for tomorrow’s challenges.

About the Role
We are seeking passionate engineers and educators to join us as Software Development Engineers & Web Development Subject Matter Experts.
This role involves contributing to hands-on learning, curriculum innovation, project development, and modern engineering education.
You will receive comprehensive, practical training on essential skills—technical, pedagogical, content creation, teaching tools, and EdTech systems.
The role blends technical engineering, academic creativity, and next-gen teaching, helping you strengthen both your engineering depth and instructional abilities.

What You Will Do
1. Academic Content & Curriculum Creation
Develop high-quality academic assets, including:
Lesson plans
Coding assignments
Real-world lab exercises
End-to-end mini and capstone projects
Create industry-aligned modules centered on Web Development, Cloud, Computer Science fundamentals, AI tools, and modern engineering practices.
Translate complex engineering concepts into simple, engaging learning experiences.
2. Project & Case Study Development
Build real-world case studies mirroring industry problems
Design practical engineering challenges for hands-on implementation
Contribute to project repositories, documentation, and solution architectures
3. Teaching & Student Engagement Support
Assist and co-facilitate technical classes, coding labs, practicals, and tutorial sessions
Conduct live demos, debugging walkthroughs, simulations, and micro-teaching sessions
Mentor students on projects, code quality, design principles, and technical best practices
4. Technology Tools & Academic Systems
Work with LMS platforms, digital evaluation systems, and content delivery tools
Track learner progress and support continuous learning using AI-driven systems
Participate in peer learning, skill reviews, and teaching effectiveness assessments
5. Continuous Learning & Innovation
Stay updated with new Web technologies, frameworks, and engineering trends
Experiment with AI-driven tools for teaching, automation, and content creation
Contribute to the evolution of an industry-oriented, future-ready technology curriculum

Technical Skills
Strong understanding of Frontend, Backend, or Full-Stack Web Development
Hands-on experience with:
HTML, CSS, JavaScript, TypeScript
React, Angular, or Vue
Node.js, Express, REST APIs
Databases: SQL / NoSQL
Version Control: Git & GitHub
Cloud basics: AWS / GCP / Azure (preferred)
Strong knowledge of Computer Science fundamentals:
Operating Systems
Database Management Systems
Computer Networks
Object-Oriented Programming & Design Patterns
Data Structures & Algorithms with problem-solving skills

Ideal Candidate Profile
Final-year M.Tech student or Ph.D. scholar in CSE, IT, ECE, Data Science, AI/ML, or related fields
Educators with prior teaching experience in Computer Science, Web Development, or Software Engineering (college-level or institute-level)
Strong grasp of Web Development (Frontend / Backend / Full-Stack) and CS fundamentals
Passion for teaching, mentoring, and academic innovation
Excellent communication, coding clarity, and presentation skills
Enthusiasm for modern engineering education and shaping future tech talent

What You Gain
Experience in an EdTech-driven engineering school at the cutting edge of CS, AI, and Cloud
Opportunity to build a strong academic and technical instructional portfolio
Hands-on mastery in curriculum design, project building, and learning experience creation
Exposure to next-gen teaching tools, AI-based learning systems, and digital pedagogy
A career pathway blending engineering, teaching, content creation, and innovation

Why Join Us?
At upGrad School of Technology, you’re not just teaching — you’re shaping engineers who will build the future.
You’ll work with cutting-edge technologies, create impactful learning experiences, and grow as both an engineer and an educator.
